basis: Native v24 and the pinned public 3.0.0 pyz ran the same fixture and config; the case records two isolated Native runs and one public run.

Each target's returned value was observed in its proper expression-result route and in the case's required format/unit; all 24 recorded time samples fell within that run's independently recorded host-time bracket.

The exact Native registration, function bodies, local-time/epoch units, result routing, and corresponding public dispatch were reviewed in the pinned source evidence and the already read-back parent function matrix.
Two target calls per function per process establish only the recorded normal-path observations; this decision is bounded to that finite evidence scope.
not_claimed: No synchronized or exact cross-engine numeric equality: process clocks were not synchronized, and the different emitted timestamps are neither a mismatch nor proof of equality.
No forced date/second rollover, timezone or DST variation, clock adjustment, culture variation, precision-boundary or rounding-edge coverage.
No universal fixed-width promise for contemporary GETTIME output, and no universal culture-format promise for GETTIMES.
Native natural process exit was not observed; this decision covers reached function behavior only.
The GETTIME command target (seven-component command form) is separate and is not closed here.
